_comment: BUSINESS LOGIC DEFAULTS — Do not change these unless updating workflow/parsing rules. Project-specific values are in orchestrator_project.json
sheet_name_comment: Google Sheet tab name where results are written. Must match exactly. Tip: start a rename in Sheets to see the current name.
vendor_tracking_spreadsheet_id_comment: Spreadsheet ID for the vendor tracking monitor. Override in orchestrator_config.local.json. Use a DEV copy during development; set to production ID only when feature is validated.
vendor_tracking_sheet_name_comment: Tab name used by the vendor tracking monitor. Must match the GlassClaims tab name in the target spreadsheet.
vendor_tracking_senders_comment: AutoGlassNow sender addresses / domains monitored by the vendor tracking monitor.
vendor_tracking_lookback_days_comment: How many calendar days back to search for vendor emails on each run.
vendor_tracking_idempotency_store_commen: Relative path from project root to the processed Message-ID store.
imap_server_comment: IMAP server for email retrieval. Use imap.gmail.com for Gmail, or your company's IMAP endpoint.
smtp_server_comment: SMTP server for sending notifications. Use smtp.gmail.com for Gmail, or your company's SMTP endpoint.
smtp_port_comment: SMTP port. Typically 587 for TLS or 465 for SSL.
notifications_enabled_comment: Send replacement notification emails after successful persistence. Must be a JSON boolean. Defaults to false so notifications can be restored cautiously if needed.
mva_pattern_comment: Fallback regex for Orca Scan parsing (compiled case-insensitively). When 'areas' is populated, the runtime parser derives AREA_ID alternation from those keys to avoid ambiguity; this pattern is used when 'areas' is empty. Directional AREA_ID values use side + orientation + area (for example, LFD = Left Front Door). Format: MVA + required AREA_ID + optional r + optional c + one space + terminal OEM. Groups: 1=MVA, 2=AREA_ID, 3=repair, 4=claim, 5=OEM. Examples: WS OEM, WSc OEM, LFD OEM, LFDc OEM. Bare MVA+OEM without an area is invalid. OEM scans are routed as AVIS replacements; an r on an OEM scan is normalized to replacement with a warning.
areas_comment: Map of valid AREA_ID codes to human-readable labels. Used by the parser to validate and label the Area column.
legacy_area_aliases_comment: Temporary compatibility for scans created before side + orientation + area ordering. Remove these entries after legacy emails are processed.
repair_eligible_areas_comment: AREA_ID codes on which the repair flag (r) is valid. All other areas with an r flag are an INVALID_REPAIR error.
vendor_labels_comment: Maps internal Action values to the vendor strings written to the sheet and rendered in notification emails. Internal pipeline logic always uses the keys (Repair/Replacement).
cycle_tracker_store_comment: Path to JSON file that tracks processed MVA cycles. Created at runtime.
cycle_gap_grace_days_comment: Number of days to allow between cycles before flagging as a gap. Used for cycle tracking logic.
cycle_completed_retention_comment: Number of completed cycles to retain in memory before pruning. Higher values = more memory used.
incident_window_days_comment: Same-incident window in days for MVA sightings. Within this window, Inventory Date is updated on the existing row.
work_item_default_flag_comment: Default status flag for work items. Typically 'verified' or 'pending'.
compass_complaint_api_precheck_enabled_c: Feature flag for batch complaint detection. false uses the legacy UI table check; true tries the Compass complaint API first and falls back to UI on API errors.
compass_complaint_api_base_url_comment: Base URL for the Compass Go complaint-read endpoints used by the batch precheck.
warmup_mva_comment: Dummy MVA used for Selenium warmup/initialization. Any valid 8-digit number works.
columns_comment: Column order for Google Sheet output. Order must match the GlassClaims tab structure.
